title: The Whispering Observatory
objective: Find the golden chalice and the silver amulet, then return to the Observatory Gates and use the golden chalice to escape.

observatory_gates.name: Observatory Gates
observatory_gates.description: Massive rusted iron gates block the entrance to the Whispering Observatory. The stone walls surrounding the estate are overgrown with dark ivy. A heavy chain with an ancient padlock binds the gates shut.

padlock.description: A heavy ancient padlock. It requires the gate_key to unlock.

on_unlock.message: The padlock clicks open, and the heavy iron gates swing outward with a loud groan!

dark_ivy.description: Thick dark ivy growing over the stone wall. Something metal glints beneath it.

on_examine.message: You part the ivy and find a rusted gate_key hanging on a stone hook!

courtyard.name: Courtyard
courtyard.description: A spacious stone courtyard. Crumbling statues of ancient astronomers stand watch. Paths lead west to the carriage house, east to the botanical greenhouse, and north into the grand foyer.

fountain.description: A dried stone fountain. Dust and withered leaves fill the basin.

carriage_house.name: Carriage House
carriage_house.description: A dusty, dark carriage house. An old wooden carriage sits rotting in the center. Tools are scattered across a workbench.

rusty_crowbar.description: A solid iron crowbar. Rusted but highly durable.

workbench.description: A wooden workbench. You might find something useful if you examine it.

on_examine.message: Under a pile of old rags, you discover an old carriage_log book!

botanical_greenhouse.name: Botanical Greenhouse
botanical_greenhouse.description: A massive glass greenhouse. Exotic, overgrown vines creep across the glass panes, blocking the sunlight. The air is warm and humid. A path leads north to the faded garden.

glowing_herb.description: A rare plant with soft blue glowing leaves.

faded_garden.name: Faded Garden
faded_garden.description: A labyrinth of overgrown hedges and dried rose bushes. In the center sits an ancient stone well. A narrow path leads north to the conservatory.

stone_well.description: An old stone well. A wooden bucket hangs over the dark depths, secured by a sturdy rope.

on_examine.message: You reel up the wooden bucket and find a rusted old_key inside!

conservatory.name: Conservatory
conservatory.description: A beautiful music room with high arched windows. A grand piano sits in the center. An exit leads west to the grand foyer.

piano.description: A polished mahogany piano. It is slightly out of tune.

silver_flute.description: A beautifully crafted silver flute that shines in the dim light.

grand_foyer.name: Grand Foyer
grand_foyer.description: A spectacular entrance hall with a polished marble floor and a sweeping double staircase leading up. Doors lead east to the conservatory, west to the salon, and north to the main gallery.

grand_chandelier.description: A massive crystal chandelier suspended from the high ceiling, catching the faint light.

salon.name: Salon
salon.description: A luxurious sitting room filled with velvet chairs, dusty drapes, and antique portraits. A cold fireplace sits in the north wall.

obsidian_mirror.description: A large mirror made of dark, polished volcanic glass.

main_gallery.name: Main Gallery
main_gallery.description: A long hall lined with detailed murals of constellations and astronomical events. Doors lead west to the library, east to the alchemist_lab, and north to the astronomy_hall.

constellation_mural.description: A mural depicting the constellation of Orion. One star seems slightly misaligned.

library.name: Library
library.description: Floor-to-ceiling bookshelves crammed with leather-bound volumes. A massive oak desk sits near a stone fireplace. A heavy rug covers the center floor.

ancient_manuscript.description: An open manuscript containing clues: 'To access the Reliquary below, light the cold blue hearth in the study. To enter the Crypt, pull the loose book in the library.'

loose_book.description: A suspicious book jutting out slightly from the shelf. Pulling it might reveal something.

on_examine.message: You pull the loose book. A clicking sound echoes, and a trapdoor is revealed beneath the heavy rug!

trapdoor.description: A wooden trapdoor leading down into the darkness.

on_unlock.message: You unlock the trapdoor, revealing stone stairs leading down into the crypt!

alchemist_lab.name: Alchemist Lab
alchemist_lab.description: A cluttered laboratory filled with glass retorts, brass scales, and jars of strange ingredients. An alchemist works quietly at a bench.

brass_scales.description: A set of accurate brass scales used for weighing reagents.

alchemist.description: An old man in stained robes, focused on a bubbling beaker.
alchemist.dialogue: Ah, a visitor. If you bring me a glowing_herb from the greenhouse, I will trade you a special alchemist_key.

underground_crypt.name: Underground Crypt
underground_crypt.description: A chilly, damp crypt beneath the library. Stone sarcophagi line the walls. A heavy iron door leads east to the reliquary.

sarcophagus.description: An ancient stone tomb covered in cobwebs.

reliquary.name: Reliquary
reliquary.description: A small stone vault designed to store holy relics. A gilded chest sits in the center.

gilded_chest.description: A chest adorned with silver engravings.

on_examine.message: You open the gilded chest and find the silver_amulet inside!

astronomy_hall.name: Astronomy Hall
astronomy_hall.description: A circular hall with a model of the solar system hanging from the ceiling. Passages lead west to the map_room and north to the massive telescope dome.

orrery.description: A mechanical model of the planets. It rotates slowly when wound.

map_room.name: Map Room
map_room.description: A room filled with star charts, celestial globes, and drafting tables. A cabinet in the corner contains navigating tools.

telescope_dome.name: Telescope Dome
telescope_dome.description: A massive copper dome housing a giant refracting telescope. A staircase leads east to the observatory_balcony. A heavy steel door leads west to the clocktower_base.

telescope.description: The great refracting telescope. It points toward the night sky.

observatory_balcony.name: Observatory Balcony
observatory_balcony.description: A wide stone balcony overlooking the misty forest. Cold air blows from the north. A staircase leads down to the high_terrace.

stone_railing.description: A crumbling stone balustrade covering the edge.

high_terrace.name: High Terrace
high_terrace.description: An open-air stone terrace connecting the upper structures of the observatory. A doorway leads east into the solar_chamber.

sun_dial.description: A marble sundial casting a sharp shadow in the moonlight.

solar_chamber.name: Solar Chamber
solar_chamber.description: A brightly decorated room symbolizing the sun. Golden ornaments hang from the walls. A heavy brass door leads north to the lunar_vault.

sun_totem.description: A heavy golden statue representing the sun.

lunar_vault.name: Lunar Vault
lunar_vault.description: A quiet, silver-accented vault. In the center, a pedestal holds a legendary chalice.

golden_chalice.description: The legendary golden chalice of the Whispering Observatory. It glows with celestial power.

clocktower_base.name: Clocktower Base
clocktower_base.description: The base of a tall stone clocktower. Dust and cobwebs cover the stone stairs leading up. A heavy iron grate blocks access to the stairs.

iron_grate.description: A heavy iron grate blocking the stairs. It is locked with a simple padlock.

on_unlock.message: You wedge the crowbar into the latch and pry the iron grate open with a satisfying crack!

clocktower_loft.name: Clocktower Loft
clocktower_loft.description: A dusty loft containing the massive gears of the observatory clock. A window looks out over the estate. A wooden ladder leads up to the bell_deck.

clock_gears.description: The giant bronze gears of the clock. They are currently locked in place.

bell_deck.name: Bell Deck
bell_deck.description: The highest point of the clocktower. A massive bronze bell hangs from the oak beams. An old wooden chest sits in the corner.

wooden_chest.description: A plain wooden chest containing spare parts.

on_examine.message: You open the wooden chest and find a heavy brass_cog inside!

upper_landing.name: Upper Landing
upper_landing.description: A dusty upper hallway at the top of the foyer stairs. Arched doorways lead east to the private study and west to the star_chamber.

carved_statue.description: A wooden statue of a celestial muse.

private_study.name: Private Study
private_study.description: A cozy room with a leather armchair and a crackling blue hearth fireplace. Lord Blackwood's spirit hovers here.

blue_hearth.description: A cold stone fireplace radiating an eerie blue light.

spirit_blackwood.description: The whispering spirit of Lord Blackwood.
spirit_blackwood.dialogue: You seek the chalice? It lies beyond the solar chamber in the Lunar Vault. Find the silver amulet in the Reliquary beneath the library to aid your escape.

star_chamber.name: Star Chamber
star_chamber.description: A chamber with a ceiling painted to resemble the night sky. In the center is a slot where a brass_cog might fit.

gear_slot.description: A bronze socket designed to hold a large cog.

on_unlock.message: You insert the brass cog. The mechanism spins, and a secret compartment pops open, revealing a second silver_amulet!

win_conditions.message: You hold up the golden chalice and the silver amulet together. A star portal bursts open in front of the Observatory Gates with a flash of brilliant celestial light! You step through the portal and escape. YOU WIN!
